assumptions: This is a generic template, not an AI-generated or repository-aware plan.
The feature needs frontend, backend, and persistent data; confirm this scope.
Refine each task against the project brief and existing code before implementation.

tasks.title: Agree on feature scope and interface contracts
tasks.description: Review the brief and existing code; define data and API boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Expected user flows and exclusions are recorded.
Request, response, validation, and error formats are agreed.

tasks.title: Design data storage and migrations
tasks.description: Define entities and constraints that support the agreed contract.
acceptance_criteria: Schema and migration approach match the feature requirements.
Migration and data integrity checks are defined.

tasks.title: Implement backend behavior
tasks.description: Implement API endpoints, validation, and persistence behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints follow the agreed contract and handle invalid input.
Backend checks cover expected behavior and failure cases.

tasks.title: Build the frontend user flow
tasks.description: Build the interface against the agreed contract using mock data.
acceptance_criteria: The primary flow includes loading, empty, and error states.
User interactions are accessible and checked against the contract.

tasks.title: Connect frontend, backend, and database
tasks.description: Replace mocks and verify the complete data flow.
acceptance_criteria: The main user flow works through the real API and persistence layer.
Configuration and error handling work across component boundaries.

tasks.title: Verify the feature and document setup
tasks.description: Run end-to-end checks and review acceptance criteria from the brief.
acceptance_criteria: The primary flow and a representative failure case pass.
Setup instructions and any remaining limitations are recorded.

brief:
Build an activity planner for a small team.

People should be able to create activities with a title, date, and description,
view upcoming activities, and edit or delete them. Save activities between sessions.

Include input validation, useful empty and error states, and a check that an activity
created in the frontend appears after reloading the page.
